record.what_it_does: Team chat and collaboration platform with channels, messaging, files, and workflows.
record.auth_notes: OAuth v2 (oauth.v2.access) gives bot (xoxb) and user (xoxp) tokens, optionally with token rotation. Tokens are sent as Bearer headers. Other options are tokens passed directly (the `token` form field), and a separate v2_user OAuth flow for the MCP server. Signing-secret verification applies to inbound events.
record.access_notes: Anyone can create an app and use OAuth for free. Unlisted public distribution needs no Marketplace review, but workspaces may require admin approval. Non-Marketplace commercial apps created after 2025-05-29 get severe limits on conversations.history/replies (1 request/min, 15 objects per call). Marketplace listing needs review. The official MCP server only accepts Marketplace or internal apps.
record.api_breadth_notes: Web API with hundreds of methods: chat, conversations, users, files, reactions, search, canvases, admin, and more. Events API and Socket Mode are also available.
record.mcp_notes: https://mcp.slack.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, confidential OAuth with client ID and secret). Only Marketplace-published and internal apps can use it.
record.blocker_notes: A Web API toolkit can be built now with a self-serve OAuth app. The main caveat is that non-Marketplace apps get low rate limits on history reads, so Marketplace review is advisable for production. The sandbox (Developer Program free sandbox workspaces) is from memory. I did not verify it because the docs page 404'd.
